verdict.rationale: Mintlify is explicitly git-based: docs live in a repo, CLI enables local preview before commits, PR preview deployments let reviewers see changes before merge, and the editor supports reviewing/merging PRs directly. This is core to Mintlify's docs-as-code model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the git workflow (only vendor docs), and no detail on branch-based environment mapping beyond PR previews.
